name: Ayane Ichijou
source:
Ayane Ichijou is a school girl with a strong sense of justice. At first she dislikes Kageaki after witnessing a “cowardly” side of him that didn’t bother to fight back against yakuza, but eventually warms up to him after finding out his identity and becomes his assistant.

[From http://awesomecurry.wordpress.com/]
